elements.element: Customer has no minimum purchase or volume commitment.
elements.evidence: Section 2.1 expressly requires Customer to purchase at least USD 2,000,000 of Services during the current twelve-month term, notwithstanding § 12.3's inconsistent acknowledgement.

elements.element: Customer pays only for usage or ordered Services.
elements.evidence: If ordered Services fall below the commitment, Customer must pay a true-up for the difference, so payment is not limited to usage or ordered Services.

elements.element: The commitment is limited to the current 12-month term.
elements.evidence: Section 2.1 limits the commitment to the current twelve-month term and states that no commitment applies to a subsequent term absent written agreement.

elements.element: Customer may reduce the commitment on 30 days' notice.
elements.evidence: Customer may reduce or terminate the commitment on 30 days' written notice.

elements.element: Any shortfall is handled through a true-up rather than a penalty.
elements.evidence: Customer's sole shortfall obligation is a true-up equal to the difference, and the clause expressly excludes penalties, liquidated damages, and accelerated Fees.
